Class DefaultSkillRegistry

java.lang.Object
tech.kayys.wayang.agent.skill.DefaultSkillRegistry
All Implemented Interfaces:
SkillRegistry
@ApplicationScoped public class DefaultSkillRegistry extends Object implements SkillRegistry
Default CDI-managed implementation of SkillRegistry.

Uses a ConcurrentHashMap for thread-safe skill storage. Built-in skills are loaded on startup by BuiltInSkillLoader.
